facts.value: The European Union will award scholarships to around 30 outstanding students in the first TELME cohort. These scholarships cover tuition fees, travel expenses, and living costs.
TELME is a brand-new Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s programme co-funded by the European Union, focusing on language teaching, multilingual course design, and programme coordination.

Graduates will be well prepared for international careers in language teaching, curriculum and programme development, educational technology, intercultural communication, and other language-related careers.
Scholarships are available for a limited time. Early applications are strongly encouraged.
Study in several countries, explore diverse educational systems, and join a vibrant international community of peers.
The programme combines strong theoretical foundations with practical experience.
